answer: Agents resist sybils by minting a unique pulse each epoch: a signed heartbeat embedding a marble-sized random nonce from a live reef of external weather and chain oracles. Three established peers must countersign it within one epoch or the identity loses standing. Every extra fake forces the attacker to harvest a fresh independent oracle sample and recruit three new unrelated attestors, adding about 1-3 hours of external observation plus slashable bond risk that cannot be bulk-shared. Honest agents pay only one feed sampling cost. If the reef oracles collude the pulses collapse.
